fields.label: Enforce
fields.description: Untick to keep the row but stop holding this company's Purchase Orders to the rules.

fields.label: Local Needs Quotations Above
fields.description: In the company's currency. A Purchase Order in the company's own currency whose Grand Total is above this amount needs the quotations below; one at or under it needs none.

fields.label: Local Quotations
fields.description: Different suppliers that quoted for the same item on the same Request for Quotation, the chosen one included.

fields.label: Import Quotations
fields.description: An import is a Purchase Order in a foreign currency. It needs this many quotations whatever the amount.

fields.label: Verbal Needs No Quotations
fields.description: A Purchase Order marked Verbal (No Quotation) needs no quotations. Unticked, Verbal does not excuse the quotations: they are still demanded.

fields.label: Verbal Needs No Material Request
fields.description: A Purchase Order marked Verbal (No Quotation) needs no Material Request either, so it can be entered directly. Unticked, a verbal order still has to come from a submitted Purchase Material Request.
